name: Spear Jaw Trap
disable: DC 30 Thievery check (expert) on the spear panels from any adjacent space, or DC 32 Nature check (master) to slowly scrape away the motion-sensitive tendrils without triggering the trap
reset: The trap resets in 1 round after a creature leaves its space.

items.name: Spear Jaws
items.text:
Trigger A Small or larger creature enters the square marked with an S

---
Effect Dozens of iron spears shoot from the floor and ceiling, impaling anyone in the space. The trap deals 8d8+16 piercing damage (DC 30 basic Reflex save save). Those that fail this save are also Immobilized until the start of their next turn when the spears retract.

text: Motion-sensitive fungus tendrils cause spears to shoot out of the floor and ceiling, almost like teeth.
